stem:
A group of figures is shown.

[image with three figures: a rectangular prism, a triangular prism, and a cube]

Which statements appear to be true about the group of figures?

options.text: All the figures have at least one triangular face.
All the figures have zero vertices.
All the figures have at least one rectangular face.

visual_elements: Three 3D figures: rectangular prism, triangular prism, and cube
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding of 3D shapes, identifying prisms, their faces, and vertices, involving modest spatial reasoning beyond basic recall.
